entities.name: UE radio capability signalling optimisation
entities.description: Optional feature that optimizes transmission of UE radio capabilities by using UE radio capability IDs instead of full capability containers.

entities.name: UE radio capability ID
entities.description: Identifier representing a set of UE radio capabilities, which can be manufacturer-assigned or network-assigned.

entities.name: REGISTRATION REQUEST
entities.description: NAS message used for registration procedures.

entities.name: REGISTRATION ACCEPT
entities.description: NAS message sent by network to accept registration.

entities.name: CONFIGURATION UPDATE COMMAND
entities.description: NAS message used for configuration updates.

entities.name: IDENTITY REQUEST
entities.description: NAS message used to request identity information from UE.

entities.name: 5GMM capability IE
entities.description: Information element indicating UE capabilities including RACS support.

entities.name: UE radio capability ID IE
entities.description: Information element carrying UE radio capability ID.

entities.name: 5GS update type IE
entities.description: Information element indicating update type including radio capability update needed.

entities.name: UE radio capability ID deletion indication IE
entities.description: Information element indicating deletion of network-assigned UE radio capability IDs.

entities.name: UE radio configuration change
entities.description: Condition where UE radio configuration changes, triggering registration procedure.

entities.name: Store network-assigned UE radio capability ID
entities.description: UE stores network-assigned UE radio capability ID with PLMN/SNPN identity and mapping to radio configuration.

entities.name: Delete network-assigned UE radio capability IDs
entities.description: UE deletes all network-assigned UE radio capability IDs for serving network when requested.

relations.description: REGISTRATION REQUEST message contains 5GMM capability IE to indicate RACS support.
REGISTRATION REQUEST message contains UE radio capability ID IE when applicable.
REGISTRATION REQUEST message contains 5GS update type IE with NG-RAN-RCU bit set.
UE radio configuration change triggers registration procedure with update type IE.
REGISTRATION ACCEPT message may contain UE radio capability ID IE for network assignment.
REGISTRATION ACCEPT message may contain UE radio capability ID deletion indication IE.
CONFIGURATION UPDATE COMMAND message may contain UE radio capability ID IE.
CONFIGURATION UPDATE COMMAND message may contain UE radio capability ID deletion indication IE.
UE radio capability ID deletion indication IE triggers deletion of network-assigned IDs.
Receiving network-assigned UE radio capability ID triggers storage procedure.
Network may send IDENTITY REQUEST to retrieve PEI from UE supporting RACS.
